searchText: Danke! Also can someone confirm EdDSA is NOT supported as a signature algorithm for ethereum Edwards generally speaking is not. It's all ECDSA when public/private keys are involved. Since EdDSA does not have public key extraction (IIUC) it is not a simple rip and replace to go to edwards, none of the transaction formats support a public key, it's all implied from the ecdsa signature.

Since EdDSA does not have public key extraction (IIUC) it is not a simple rip and replace to go to edwards, none of the transaction formats support a public key, it's all implied from the ecdsa signature.
